description: Normalised 0–100. Significant relationship events are addressed by time_x.
Normalised 0–100. Qualitative influence, not a physical measurement unit.
Curves are defined by significant events (origin, peak, decline, zero, re-emergence, plateau, bifurcation, capture) rather than one property = one curve.
Patterned property circles indicate which material properties participate at particular moments; they do not define whole curves.
Windows of Influence should be derived from the significant relationship segments/events they describe, not from equal timeline phase rectangles.
CRV-04 includes an explicit bifurcation and branch IDs A/B.

The nine colours come from the user's cleaned diagnostic image and exist only to distinguish the nine curves during reconstruction. Final graph should return to the original monochrome/grey hierarchy.
Current event coordinates are approximate tracings from the cleaned reference images and should be visually refined after the first event-driven SVG render.
